text:
maria.p: Quick async check on Q2 milestone status — tiny update thread so PM/eng can gap-match.
alex.k: shipped: runtime-v3 canary (limited to eu-west), embeddings cache landed in prod. :tada:
kevin_r: slipped: deduped model-routing A/B because of perf regressions on long context (we hit a 12% token latency bump). working on root cause.
sara_t: owners: runtime-v3 canary -> alex.k, embeddings cache followups -> sara_t, model-routing rollback/hotfix -> kevin_r.
maria.p: product acceptance notes: embeddings cache needs API contract for cache-control headers before we mark as done. alex can you confirm ETA?
alex.k: ETA for headers + tests = EOD Thursday. Will add migration note.
kevin_r: model-routing rollback is staged, will run a canary tonight then full rollback if no issues. PR queued: `github.com/redwood/route/PR#452` — can reviewers pls glance? @sara_t @maria.p
sara_t: I can review tomorrow morning, will also run the regression test harness. If rollback needed, does infra need a config flip?
kevin_r: yes — flip is in `infra/route-flags` (ops only). I've queued `deploy-bot` for an ops notification.
deploy-bot: [auto] scheduled canary rollback window 23:30 UTC. Ops ticket: #8765.
maria.p: dependencies: dedicated infra team to approve flag flip and allocated 2h on-call during window. ops / eng-infra please confirm.
alex.k: ops confirmed in #eng-infra earlier, but re-pinging @devops for final signoff.
sara_t: CR pings: two small CRs on embeddings cache (latency test refactor + header propagation). tagging @alex.k and @kevin_r.
alex.k: will address comments by noon.
kevin_r: re: performance regression, I'm bisecting kernel changes; if we can't land quick fix, plan B is to route long-context requests to legacy-optimized model until fix.
maria.p: product decision: prefer routing fallback over user-facing latency. Kevin, please prepare fallback config and a short rollback doc (1-2 bullets) so support can communicate.
kevin_r: will drop doc in this thread and link to PR.
sara_t: any blockers from legal/compliance for the fallback?
maria.p: none for now, it's internal routing change. we'll escalate if needed.
alex.k: follow-ups: I'll add cache-control header PR, update changelog, and ping QA.
kevin_r: final note: telemetry shows error spike correlated with a specific deployment job at 11:42 UTC — I'm isolating the change.
maria.p: thanks all. Next steps: alex (headers) by Thu EOD, kevin (rollback plan + doc) by tonight post-canary, sara (CR + regression tests) by tomorrow morning. I'll sync with support to prepare a short customer-facing note if rollback occurs. :white_check_mark:
alex.k: ack.
sara_t: ack.
kevin_r: ack — will post PR link once ready.
deploy-bot: [auto] ticket #8765 updated: canary rollback window completed without service interruption.
